description: Starts an automated real-browser scan of a public website to check its cookie consent behaviour: cookies and trackers set before consent, whether a consent banner appears, and whether rejecting consent is honoured. Side effect: queues a new scan on GDPR Privacy Monitor, unless the same URL was scanned through this server in the last 24 hours or is being scanned right now, in which case that scan is returned instead. Returns the scan_id, its status and a link to the web report; a scan usually finishes within one to two minutes, after which get_scan_result returns the findings. Only http(s) URLs of publicly reachable sites are accepted. New scans are subject to a daily capacity limit; when it is reached the tool returns an error with a link for running the scan on the website instead. Documentation: https://gdprprivacymonitor.eu/en/developers/mcp

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.

url.description: The website to scan, for example https://example.com or example.com.

name: scan_website
title: Scan a website's cookie consent
